<!--
Child document of HALE_Summit_WSVA.Rmd. It holds all data compilation, analysis and
figures for the Summit District report, and renders the appendix (methods, strengths,
weaknesses, code). HALE_Summit_WSVA.Rmd knits it first (knitr::knit_child) so the main
text can use its results, then prints it at the end. Reusable steps are functions in
hi_src/ (any Hawaiʻi site); data access uses src/. Data are cached under hi_datasets/.
-->

```{r settings-copy, eval = FALSE, include = FALSE}
source("setup.R")
# SETTINGS AND ASSUMPTIONS
park <- "HALE"
C_eff <- 0.8               # {{ASSUMPTION}} share of rain on the catchment that reaches the tanks
dem_gpd <- 5000            # {{ASSUMPTION}} constant demand, gallons per day (no metered data)
catchment_acres <- NA      # {{ASSUMPTION}} NA = just large enough for dem_gpd in the present-day run
demand_end <- 2025         # last calendar year of visitation data
rerun_downloads <- FALSE   # TRUE: re-download every input (an hour or more); FALSE: read saved copies
wet_months <- c(11L, 12L, 1:4)                 # Hawaiʻi wet season, Nov-Apr
days_in_month <- c(31, 28.25, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31)
gal_per_liter <- 0.264172
m2_per_acre <- 4046.856
options(hi.fig_dir = file.path("data", "park", park, "Figs"))
theme_cf <- theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95"), strip.text = element_text(colour = "black", face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "bottom")
fig_ids <- c("map", "trend", "shadow", "hrcm", "hrcm_ts", "monthly", "visits", "storage", "need", "storms", "cells")
tab_ids <- c("bluf", "trend", "hrcm")
fref <- function(id) paste("Figure", match(id, fig_ids))
tref <- function(id) paste("Table", match(id, tab_ids))
fcap <- function(id, text) paste0(fref(id), ": ", text)
tcap <- function(id, text) paste0(tref(id), ": ", text)
assume <- function(x) paste0("{{ASSUMPTION: ", x, "}}")
figs <- list(); tabs <- list()
```


```{r proc-download, include = FALSE}
# ---- Inputs: where every file this script reads comes from ---------------------------------
# With rerun_downloads <- TRUE (set in the report's settings) this chunk re-downloads every
# external input and overwrites the saved copies; it takes an hour or more. With FALSE (the
# usual case) nothing is downloaded and the later chunks read the saved copies below.
# Not downloadable: the NPS Water Supply Database (data/Water_Supply_Systems/
# NPS_Water_Systems_Database_Joined.xlsx), an internal NPS file read by get_wsd(), and the
# project's archive of NPS park alerts (data/all/nps_alerts/tidy/, daily snapshots of every
# park's posted alerts, 2019 on).
# rerun_downloads <- TRUE
f_boundary <- file.path("hi_datasets", paste0(park, "_park_boundary.gpkg"))       # NPS park boundary
f_setting <- file.path("hi_datasets", paste0(park, "_system_setting.csv"))        # each system's physical setting
ridb_dir <- file.path("data", "park", park, "RIDBFullExport_V1_CSV")              # recreation.gov facilities and campsites
nex_dir <- file.path("hi_datasets", park)                                         # HCDP daily rain maps (observed)
f_stations <- file.path("hi_datasets", paste0(park, "_ghcnd_stations.gpkg"))      # GHCN-Daily rain gauges near the park
f_gauge_prcp <- file.path("hi_datasets", paste0(park, "_ghcnd_prcp.parquet"))     # their daily rain
hrcm_dir <- file.path("hi_datasets", paste0(park, "_hrcm"))                       # regional climate model, hourly rain
f_visits <- file.path("hi_datasets", paste0(park, "_visitation_monthly.parquet")) # NPS visitor statistics
f_res <- file.path("hi_datasets", paste0(park, "_ridb_reservations.parquet"))     # recreation.gov reservations
f_oni <- file.path("hi_datasets", "noaa_oni.txt")                                 # Oceanic Niño Index (El Niño / La Niña)
f_pdo <- file.path("hi_datasets", "noaa_pdo.txt")                                 # Pacific Decadal Oscillation index
f_storm <- file.path("hi_datasets", "HI_storm_events.parquet")                   # NOAA Storm Events, Hawaiʻi
f_alerts <- file.path("hi_datasets", paste0(park, "_nws_alerts_HIZ022.parquet")) # NWS alerts, Haleakalā summit zone
park_alerts_dir <- file.path("data", "all", "nps_alerts", "tidy")              # NPS park alerts (project archive)
# What to fetch
gauge_use <- c(USC00511004 = "Summit District gauge", USC00515000 = "Kula gauge")   # Haleakalā Ranger Station; Kula Branch Station
hr_runs <- c(present = "maui_present", cf1 = "maui_rcp45", cf2 = "maui_rcp85")
res_ids <- c(hosmer = "10068557", sunrise = "253731")      # Hosmer Grove Campground; summit sunrise
res_years <- 2017:2025                                     # fiscal years of reservation files
# Reads a GeoPackage with its geometry column named "geometry"
read_gpkg <- function(f) { x <- sf::st_read(f, quiet = TRUE); sf::st_geometry(x) <- "geometry"; x }

if (rerun_downloads) {
  old_timeout <- options(timeout = 3600)                   # allow large files
  pts_dl <- get_wsd(conus = FALSE) %>% dplyr::filter(park_unit == park) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(wsd_system_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% sf::st_transform(4326)
  # Park boundary (NPS IRMA)
  bnd <- getParkBoundary(park = park)
  sf::st_write(bnd, f_boundary, delete_dsn = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)
  # Physical setting of each water system (Hawaiʻi Statewide GIS layers + USGS elevation)
  unlink(f_setting)
  hi_site_setting(pts_dl, "wsd_system_id", cache = f_setting)
  # recreation.gov facility and campsite tables (RIDB full export, ~250 MB zip)
  zip <- tempfile(fileext = ".zip")
  utils::download.file("https://ridb.recreation.gov/downloads/RIDBFullExport_V1_CSV.zip", zip, mode = "wb", quiet = TRUE)
  utils::unzip(zip, exdir = ridb_dir, junkpaths = TRUE, overwrite = TRUE); unlink(zip)
  # HCDP daily rain maps, every year from 1990 to yesterday, the park's 250-m cells only
  get_hcdp_obs_park(park = park, output_dir = nex_dir, park_boundary = bnd,
                    years = 1990:as.integer(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y")), overwrite = TRUE)
  # GHCN-Daily rain gauges within 10 km of the park, and the daily rain of the two used here
  # (rnoaa::meteo_pull_monitors() returns tenths of a mm)
  st <- get_ghcnd_near_park(bnd, buffer_km = 10, element = "PRCP")
  sf::st_write(st, f_stations, delete_dsn = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)
  rnoaa::meteo_pull_monitors(names(gauge_use), var = "PRCP", date_min = "1950-01-01", date_max = as.character(Sys.Date())) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(prcp_mm = prcp / 10) %>% dplyr::select(id, date, prcp_mm) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(sf::st_drop_geometry(st) %>% dplyr::select(id, name, elevation), by = "id") %>%
    arrow::write_parquet(f_gauge_prcp)
  # Regional climate model: hourly rain for the 3 x 3 cells around each system, three runs
  hi_hrcm_download(pts_dl, hrcm_dir, runs = unname(hr_runs), id_col = "wsd_system_id", n = 3, overwrite = TRUE)
  # ... and hourly 10-m wind for the Summit District's 9 cells only
  hi_hrcm_download_wind(data.table::fread(file.path(hrcm_dir, "_cells.csv"))[wsd_system_id == "HALE_WS_001"], hrcm_dir,
                        runs = unname(hr_runs), overwrite = TRUE)
  # NPS visitor statistics (IRMA), monthly, 1979 on
  arrow::write_parquet(getUnitVisitation(units = park, startYear = 1979, endYear = demand_end, allStats = TRUE), f_visits)
  # recreation.gov reservations for the two facilities (yearly national files, 0.1-0.5 GB each)
  get_ridb_reservations(res_years, res_ids, raw_dir = file.path("hi_datasets", "ridb_reservations_raw"),
                        out_file = f_res, overwrite = TRUE)
  # El Niño / La Niña (NOAA CPC Oceanic Niño Index) and the Pacific Decadal Oscillation (NOAA NCEI)
  utils::download.file("https://www.cpc.ncep.noaa.gov/data/indices/oni.ascii.txt", f_oni, quiet = TRUE)
  utils::download.file("https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/pub/data/cmb/ersst/v5/index/ersst.v5.pdo.dat", f_pdo, quiet = TRUE)
  # Past storms: NOAA Storm Events for Hawaiʻi (1996 on) and NWS alerts for the Haleakalā summit zone
  get_storm_events("HAWAII", 1996:as.integer(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y")), out_file = f_storm, overwrite = TRUE)
  arrow::write_parquet(get_nws_alerts("HIZ022"), f_alerts)
  options(old_timeout)
  # The NPS Park Tiles basemaps are re-downloaded by tiles_for() in proc-figures.
}
```

```{r proc-systems, include = FALSE}
wsd <- get_wsd(conus = FALSE) %>% dplyr::filter(park_unit == park)
# One point per water system (the source id's are duplicated coordinates, and we care only about rain)
pts_all <- wsd %>% dplyr::distinct(wsd_system_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% sf::st_transform(4326)
sys_lab <- c(HALE_WS_001 = "Summit District", HALE_WS_002 = "Kīpahulu", HALE_WS_003 = "Kapalaoa cabin",
             HALE_WS_004 = "Palikū cabins", HALE_WS_005 = "Hōlua cabins", HALE_WS_006 = "Haleakalā Visitor Center (UT-21)")
pts_all$label <- sys_lab[pts_all$wsd_system_id]
summit_pt <- pts_all %>% dplyr::filter(wsd_system_id == "HALE_WS_001") %>% dplyr::mutate(system = "Summit District")
wv <- function(id, col) unique(sf::st_drop_geometry(wsd)[wsd$wsd_system_id == id, col])   # one WSD field for one system
summit_storage <- as.numeric(wv("HALE_WS_001", "storage_capacity_gallons"))
# Treatment step for the tank model: the storage is two 250,000-gal raw-water tanks and one 50,000-gal
# treated-water tank (WSD description), joined by slow sand filters that treat about 8,000-9,000 gal
# a day (NPS Office of Public Health inspections, 2013-2022); the lower figure is used
treated_gal <- 50000
filter_gpd <- 8000
# Each system's physical setting (geology, soil, aquifer, watershed, moisture zone, land cover,
# elevation), looked up from statewide GIS layers by hi_site_setting() in proc-download
setting <- as.data.frame(readr::read_csv(f_setting, show_col_types = FALSE))
# sset(id, col): look up one setting value for one water system, e.g.
# sset("HALE_WS_001", "elev_ft") -> the Summit District catchment's elevation (ft).
# `setting` has one row per WSD system (geology, soil, watershed, moisture zone, land cover,
# elevation); [1] returns a single value even if a system appears twice.
sset <- function(id, col) setting[setting$wsd_system_id == id, col][1]
park_boundary <- read_gpkg(f_boundary)                                 # NPS park boundary polygon

# Visitor centers and Hosmer Grove campground capacity (recreation.gov RIDB export).
# hi_ridb_capacity(): reads the RIDB facility and campsite tables for the park's recreation area;
# returns facilities (`fac`, with coordinates) and sites/people per night by place (`cap_place`).
ridb <- hi_ridb_capacity(ridb_dir, anchor_facility = "Hosmer Grove",
                         places = c(Hosmer = "Hosmer Grove"))
vc <- ridb$fac[grepl("Haleakal.* Visitor Center", FacilityName) & !grepl("Headquarters", FacilityName)][1]
hq_vc <- ridb$fac[grepl("Headquarters Visitor Center", FacilityName)][1]
hosmer_cap <- ridb$cap_place[place == "Hosmer Grove"]
```

```{r proc-observed, include = FALSE}
# ---- Observed rain: HCDP daily rain maps, 250-m grid (Longman et al. 2019) ----------------
# Reads (does not download) every day of observed rain saved in the local data store
# (hi_datasets/HALE/, written by get_hcdp_obs_park() in proc-download): daily grids as parquet
# files, partitioned by variable/scenario/model, plus _cells.parquet listing each grid cell's
# location and how much of it lies in the park. Currently January 1990 through the latest
# download. No year filter is applied here; later steps keep only complete Hawaiʻi water years
# (Nov-Oct), 1991-2025.
nex_cells <- arrow::read_parquet(file.path(nex_dir, "_cells.parquet"))
nex <- arrow::open_dataset(nex_dir)
# hi_site_cells(): the grid cell containing the system plus its neighbors (n = 3 -> a 3 x 3 block,
# ~750 m across), so one odd cell does not dominate
sc <- hi_site_cells(summit_pt, nex_cells, id_col = "system", n = 3)
# hi_site_daily(): reads those cells from the store and averages them into one daily rain series (mm)
obs <- hi_site_daily(nex %>% dplyr::filter(variable == "pr", scenario == "observed", cell_id %in% !!sc$cell_id), sc)
data.table::setorder(obs, date)
# hi_water_year(): Hawaiʻi water year, Nov-Oct, named for the year it ends (Nov 2024 -> 2025)
obs[, `:=`(wy = hi_water_year(year, month), season = data.table::fifelse(month %in% wet_months, "wet", "dry"))]
obs_last <- max(obs[!is.na(pr)]$date)
obs_na_days <- obs[is.na(pr)]$date                                    # missing at the source
base_wy <- obs[, .(n = .N, n_m = data.table::uniqueN(month)), by = wy][n >= 365 & n_m == 12]$wy   # complete water years only
base <- obs[wy %in% base_wy]                                           # complete water years (a day missing at the source stays NA)

# Park outline on the 250-m grid (cells at least half inside the park), and mean annual rain for the maps
cov_r <- terra::rast(as.data.frame(nex_cells[, c("lon", "lat", "coverage_fraction")]), type = "xyz", crs = "EPSG:4326")
cov_r[cov_r < 0.5] <- NA; cov_r[!is.na(cov_r)] <- 1
park_poly <- sf::st_as_sf(terra::as.polygons(cov_r))
# hi_wy_grid(): total rain in every grid cell for every water year (one row per cell and year)
obs_wy <- hi_wy_grid(nex %>% dplyr::filter(variable == "pr", scenario == "observed"))
obs_wy[n_na > 0, mm := mm * n / (n - n_na)]                              # scale years with missing days to a full year
iso_wy <- sort(obs_wy[, .(n = max(n)), by = wy][n >= 365]$wy)
# hi_wy_raster(): turns those totals into a map (raster) of mean annual rain over the chosen years
mean_r <- hi_wy_raster(obs_wy, nex_cells, iso_wy)
names(mean_r) <- "pr_mm"
# Mean annual rain; a year with a missing day is scaled up by its share of days observed (as for the gauges)
summit_mean_in <- mean(base[, .(mm = sum(pr, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(!is.na(pr))), by = wy]$mm) / 25.4

# ---- Has the rain-shadow line moved? (2,000-mm isohyet by 5-year period; area by water year) ----
iso_per <- data.table::data.table(p0 = seq(1991L, 2021L, by = 5L))[, p1 := pmin(p0 + 4L, max(iso_wy))]
stopifnot(all(unlist(Map(`:`, iso_per$p0, iso_per$p1)) %in% iso_wy))
iso_per[, lab := paste0(p0, "-", p1)]
n_per <- nrow(iso_per)
iso_r <- lapply(seq_len(n_per), function(i) hi_wy_raster(obs_wy, nex_cells, iso_per$p0[i]:iso_per$p1[i]))   # one rain map per period
# isohyet_line(): traces the contour where rain equals threshold_mm (here the 2,000-mm "rain-shadow
# line") and keeps its longest piece
iso_lines <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(n_per), function(i)
  dplyr::mutate(isohyet_line(iso_r[[i]], threshold_mm = 2000, source = iso_per$lab[i]), period = iso_per$lab[i])))
iso_lines$period <- factor(iso_lines$period, iso_per$lab)
# hi_compare_isohyets(): compares the first and last period's maps and lines (cell-by-cell change,
# distance the line moved)
iso_cmp <- hi_compare_isohyets(iso_r[[n_per]], iso_r[[1]], iso_lines[n_per, ], iso_lines[1, ], threshold_mm = 2000)
# Area of each grid cell (km²), to add up the area above a rain threshold
cell_km2 <- data.table::data.table(cell_id = nex_cells$cell_id,
                                   km2 = terra::extract(terra::cellSize(iso_r[[1]], unit = "km"), as.matrix(nex_cells[, c("lon", "lat")]))[[1]])
# Park area (km²) receiving at least `thr` mm of rain, for each water year
iso_area_at <- function(thr) data.table::setorder(merge(obs_wy[wy %in% iso_wy], cell_km2, by = "cell_id")[, .(km2 = sum(km2[mm >= thr])), by = wy], wy)
iso_area <- iso_area_at(2000)                                          # sorted: trend tests need time order
# Trend in that area: Sen's slope (the median of all year-to-year slopes, robust to outliers;
# x10 = per decade) and the Mann-Kendall test (does the series tend to rise or fall?)
iso_trend <- list(sen = 10 * unname(trend::sens.slope(iso_area$km2)$estimates), p = trend::mk.test(iso_area$km2)$p.value,
                  first = mean(iso_area[wy %in% iso_per$p0[1]:iso_per$p1[1]]$km2),
                  last = mean(iso_area[wy %in% iso_per$p0[n_per]:iso_per$p1[n_per]]$km2))
grid_km2 <- sum(cell_km2$km2)
# The 2,000-mm line for every single water year (for the figure)
iso_lines_wy <- do.call(rbind, lapply(iso_wy, function(y) {
  l <- tryCatch(isohyet_line(hi_wy_raster(obs_wy, nex_cells, y), threshold_mm = 2000, source = as.character(y)), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(l) || !nrow(l)) NULL else dplyr::mutate(l[, "geometry"], wy = y) }))

# ---- El Niño / La Niña and the Pacific Decadal Oscillation, by Hawaiʻi water year ----------
# ENSO: the Oceanic Niño Index for the winter (Dec-Feb) inside the water year; El Niño at
# >= +0.5 °C, La Niña at <= -0.5 °C, otherwise neutral (NOAA CPC thresholds). PDO: the mean of
# the monthly PDO index over the water year (Nov-Oct); positive or negative phase.
oni <- data.table::fread(f_oni)[SEAS == "DJF", .(wy = YR, oni = ANOM)]
oni[, enso := data.table::fcase(oni >= 0.5, "El Niño", oni <= -0.5, "La Niña", default = "Neutral")]
pdo <- data.table::fread(f_pdo, skip = 1, header = TRUE)
pdo <- data.table::melt(pdo, id.vars = "Year", variable.name = "mon", value.name = "pdo")[pdo < 90]
pdo[, month := match(as.character(mon), month.abb)][, wy := hi_water_year(Year, month)]
pdo <- pdo[, .(pdo = mean(pdo), n = .N), by = wy][n == 12][, phase := ifelse(pdo >= 0, "Positive PDO", "Negative PDO")]
climate_wy <- merge(oni, pdo[, .(wy, pdo, phase)], by = "wy", all = TRUE)
# Rain-shadow area by ENSO phase (water years with both)
iso_enso <- merge(iso_area, climate_wy, by = "wy")[, .(km2 = mean(km2), n = .N), by = enso]

# Sensitivity: the same trend test for the areas above 1,000 and 3,000 mm
iso_sens <- data.table::rbindlist(lapply(c(1000, 2000, 3000), function(thr) { a <- iso_area_at(thr)
  data.table::data.table(mm = thr, sen = 10 * unname(trend::sens.slope(a$km2)$estimates), p = trend::mk.test(a$km2)$p.value) }))
```

```{r proc-gauges, include = FALSE}
# ---- Rain gauges: the Summit District's own gauge and the nearest long leeward record ----
# NOAA GHCN-Daily (Menne et al. 2012), from proc-download: the gauges within 10 km of the park
# (get_ghcnd_near_park(): location, elevation, years of record) and the daily rain of the two
# used here (gauge_use, set in proc-download)
gauges <- read_gpkg(f_stations)
gauge_prcp <- data.table::as.data.table(arrow::read_parquet(f_gauge_prcp))
gauge_meta <- data.table::as.data.table(sf::st_drop_geometry(gauges))[id %in% names(gauge_use)]
# calc_precip_indices(): per site and water year, annual/wet-season/dry-season totals, rain days
# (>= 1 mm), heavy days (>= 25.4 mm), longest dry spells, wettest days. A year counts only when
# at least 90% of its days were observed (min_complete). Totals and day counts are scaled up by
# the share of days observed (scale_missing), so years with more gaps do not look drier.
gi <- gauge_prcp[id %in% names(gauge_use), .(site = gauge_use[id], date, prcp_mm)] %>%
  calc_precip_indices(wet_day_mm = 1, heavy_day_mm = 25.4, min_complete = 0.9, scale_missing = TRUE) %>% data.table::as.data.table()
hcdp_i <- obs[, .(site = "HCDP map, Summit District", date, prcp_mm = pr)] %>%
  calc_precip_indices(wet_day_mm = 1, heavy_day_mm = 25.4, min_complete = 0.9, scale_missing = TRUE) %>% data.table::as.data.table()
hcdp_i <- hcdp_i[water_year %in% base_wy]
# Summit rain (HCDP map) by El Niño / La Niña phase and by the PDO index
summit_cl <- merge(hcdp_i[, .(wy = water_year, inch = annual_mm / 25.4)], climate_wy, by = "wy")
summit_enso <- summit_cl[, .(inch = mean(inch), n = .N), by = enso]
summit_enso_p <- c(en_ln = stats::wilcox.test(summit_cl[enso == "El Niño"]$inch, summit_cl[enso == "La Niña"]$inch)$p.value,
                   neutral = stats::wilcox.test(summit_cl[enso == "Neutral"]$inch, summit_cl[enso != "Neutral"]$inch)$p.value)
summit_pdo <- summit_cl[, .(inch = mean(inch), neutral = mean(enso == "Neutral"), n = .N), by = phase]
summit_pdo_cor <- stats::cor.test(summit_cl$inch, summit_cl$pdo, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
rs_lab <- gauge_use[["USC00511004"]]
rs <- gi[site == rs_lab]
idx <- c(annual_mm = "Annual rain", wet_season_mm = "Wet-season rain (Nov-Apr)", dry_season_mm = "Dry-season rain (May-Oct)",
         wet_days = "Rain days (≥ 0.04 in)", cdd_dry_season = "Longest dry-season dry spell", heavy_days = "Heavy-rain days (≥ 1 in)")
# Sen's slope (per decade) and Mann-Kendall p-value for each measure in `idx`, for one record
trend_of <- function(d, site_lab) data.table::rbindlist(lapply(names(idx), function(v) {
  y <- d[order(water_year)][[v]]
  data.table::data.table(site = site_lab, index = v, years = paste(min(d$water_year), max(d$water_year), sep = "-"), n = length(y),
                         sen = 10 * unname(trend::sens.slope(y)$estimates), p = trend::mk.test(y)$p.value, mean = mean(y))
}))
g_trend <- rbind(trend_of(rs, rs_lab), trend_of(gi[site == gauge_use[["USC00515000"]]], gauge_use[["USC00515000"]]),
                 trend_of(hcdp_i, "HCDP map, Summit District"))
g_trend[, pct_dec := 100 * sen / mean]
# Check: the Summit District gauge's rain-day trend using only years with at most 3 missing days
rs_strict <- trend_of(rs[n_missing <= 3], rs_lab)[index == "wet_days"][, pct_dec := 100 * sen / mean]
# ... and with missing days counted as dry (no scaling), for comparison
rs_noscale <- trend_of(data.table::as.data.table(calc_precip_indices(gauge_prcp[id == "USC00511004", .(site = rs_lab, date, prcp_mm)],
                         wet_day_mm = 1, heavy_day_mm = 25.4, min_complete = 0.9)), rs_lab)[index == "wet_days"][, pct_dec := 100 * sen / mean]
# Gauge vs. HCDP map at the Summit District, overlapping complete water years
ov <- merge(rs[, .(water_year, g = annual_mm)], hcdp_i[, .(water_year, h = annual_mm)], by = "water_year")
ov_r <- stats::cor(ov$g, ov$h)
# Timing: mean monthly rain at the gauge, first vs. second 30 years of its complete record
rs_m <- gauge_prcp[id == "USC00511004" & !is.na(prcp_mm)][, `:=`(wy = hi_water_year(as.integer(format(date, "%Y")), as.integer(format(date, "%m"))),
                                                               month = as.integer(format(date, "%m")))][wy %in% rs$water_year]
rs_split <- stats::median(rs$water_year)
rs_mon <- rs_m[, .(mm = mean(prcp_mm) * days_in_month[month[1]]), by = .(half = ifelse(wy <= rs_split, "early", "late"), month)]
rs_halves <- c(early = paste(min(rs$water_year), floor(rs_split), sep = "-"), late = paste(floor(rs_split) + 1, max(rs$water_year), sep = "-"))
```

```{r proc-hrcm, include = FALSE}
# ---- Hawaiʻi Regional Climate Model (Zhang 2017): present-day and late-century runs ------
# Hourly rain for the 3 x 3 cells (0.8 km) around each WSD point, one parquet per run, saved by
# hi_hrcm_download() in proc-download (runs listed in hr_runs there); _cells.csv lists each
# system's cells. Keep the Summit District's 9 cells.
hr_cells <- data.table::fread(file.path(hrcm_dir, "_cells.csv"))[wsd_system_id == "HALE_WS_001"]
# Hourly rain at the Summit District: the mean of its 9 cells, for each run
hr_hourly <- data.table::rbindlist(lapply(names(hr_runs), function(r) {
  x <- data.table::as.data.table(arrow::read_parquet(file.path(hrcm_dir, paste0(hr_runs[[r]], ".parquet"))))
  merge(hr_cells[, .(we, sn)], x, by = c("we", "sn"))[, .(rain_mm = mean(rain_mm)), by = time_utc][, run := r]
}))
# hi_hrcm_daily(): sums hourly rain into Hawaiʻi Standard Time days; drops days missing any hour
hr_daily <- hr_hourly[, hi_hrcm_daily(.SD[, .(system = "Summit District", time_utc, rain_mm)], "system"), by = run]
hr_wys <- 1991:2009                                                   # complete water years in the runs
# Every day of those water years; days with missing hours in the source count as dry (the
# tank model needs every day)
hr_days <- seq(as.Date(paste0(min(hr_wys) - 1, "-11-01")), as.Date(paste0(max(hr_wys), "-10-31")), by = "day")
hr_daily <- merge(data.table::CJ(run = names(hr_runs), date = hr_days), hr_daily[, .(run, date, pr)], by = c("run", "date"), all.x = TRUE)
# Days missing some hours (a gap in the source, or the hour a run's running total restarts) are
# filled from their valid hours, scaled to 24 hours (hours assigned to days as in hi_hrcm_daily())
hr_part <- hr_hourly[, .(run, date = as.Date(time_utc - 3600 - 10 * 3600, tz = "UTC"), rain_mm)][
  , .(n_valid = sum(!is.na(rain_mm)), mm = sum(rain_mm, na.rm = TRUE)), by = .(run, date)]
hr_miss <- merge(hr_daily[is.na(pr), .(run, date)], hr_part, by = c("run", "date"), all.x = TRUE)[, pr_fill := mm * 24 / n_valid]
stopifnot(all(hr_miss$n_valid >= 6))                                   # at least a quarter of the day observed
hr_daily[hr_miss, on = .(run, date), pr := i.pr_fill]
# fdate(): "March 15, 1999"-style dates for the appendix text
fdate <- function(d) paste0(month.name[as.integer(format(d, "%m"))], " ", as.integer(format(d, "%d")), ", ", format(d, "%Y"))
hr_miss_txt <- hr_miss[, .(d = paste0(fdate(date), " (", n_valid, " of 24 hours)", collapse = " and ")), by = run][
  , paste0(d, " in the ", c(present = "present-day run", cf1 = "Climate Future 1 run", cf2 = "Climate Future 2 run")[run], collapse = "; ")]
hr_daily[, month := as.integer(format(date, "%m"))]
hr_daily[, `:=`(wy = hi_water_year(as.integer(format(date, "%Y")), month), wet = month %in% wet_months)]

# ---- Correct the model's rain amounts: one factor per season (wet Nov-Apr, dry May-Oct), set so
# the present-day run's mean rain equals observed rain at the same place over the same water
# years; the same factors apply to both futures. The model's own sequence of rain and dry days,
# and its changes in them, are kept.
stopifnot(!anyNA(obs[wy %in% hr_wys]$pr))                              # no missing days in 1991-2009
obs_hr <- obs[wy %in% hr_wys, .(date, pr, wy, month, wet = month %in% wet_months)]
data.table::setorder(obs_hr, date)
stopifnot(length(obs_hr$date) == length(hr_days), all(as.numeric(obs_hr$date) == as.numeric(hr_days)))
hr_k <- merge(obs_hr[, .(obs = mean(pr)), by = wet], hr_daily[run == "present", .(model = mean(pr)), by = wet], by = "wet")[, k := obs / model]
hr_daily[, pr_raw := pr][, pr := pr_raw * hr_k$k[match(wet, hr_k$wet)]]
data.table::setorder(hr_daily, run, date)

# Per water year, the measures that matter for a catchment (rain in mm; a rain day is >= 1 mm).
# hi_longest_run(): length of the longest unbroken run of TRUE values (e.g. dry days in a row).
wy_stats <- function(d) d[wy %in% hr_wys][order(date)][, .(
  ann = sum(pr), wet_mm = sum(pr[wet]), dry_mm = sum(pr[!wet]),
  dry_days = sum(pr < 1), cdd = hi_longest_run(pr < 1), cdd_dry = hi_longest_run(pr[!wet] < 1),
  rain_days = sum(pr >= 1), sdii = mean(pr[pr >= 1]), heavy = sum(pr >= 25.4),
  cwd = hi_longest_run(pr >= 1), wet_spell = { r <- rle(pr >= 1); mean(r$lengths[r$values]) },
  rx1 = max(pr), rx3 = max(data.table::frollsum(pr, 3), na.rm = TRUE)), by = wy]
# Largest single-hour rain in each water year, corrected with the same seasonal factors
hr_hmax <- hr_hourly[!is.na(rain_mm)][, month := as.integer(format(time_utc - 10 * 3600, "%m"))][
  , `:=`(wy = hi_water_year(as.integer(format(time_utc - 10 * 3600, "%Y")), month),
         rain_mm = rain_mm * hr_k$k[match(month %in% wet_months, hr_k$wet)])][
  wy %in% hr_wys, .(hmax = max(rain_mm)), by = .(run, wy)]
hr_wy <- merge(hr_daily[, wy_stats(.SD), by = run], hr_hmax, by = c("run", "wy"))
hr_meas <- c(ann = "Annual rain", wet_mm = "Wet-season rain (Nov-Apr)", dry_mm = "Dry-season rain (May-Oct)",
             dry_days = "Dry days (< 0.04 in)", cdd = "Longest dry spell", cdd_dry = "Longest dry-season dry spell",
             rain_days = "Rain days (≥ 0.04 in)", sdii = "Rain per rain day", heavy = "Heavy-rain days (≥ 1 in)",
             wet_spell = "Average wet spell", cwd = "Longest wet spell", rx1 = "Wettest day", rx3 = "Wettest 3 days",
             hmax = "Largest hourly rain")
# Dry spells long enough to matter for wildfire: grasses become flammable after 14 days without rain
# and can carry large fires after 30 (NPS, 2024); counted within each Hawaiʻi water year
fire_dry <- hr_daily[wy %in% hr_wys][order(run, date)][, { r <- rle(pr < 1); L <- r$lengths[r$values]
  .(n14 = sum(L >= 14), any30 = any(L >= 30)) }, by = .(run, wy)][, .(n14 = mean(n14), p30 = 100 * mean(any30)), by = run]
# Change in each future vs. the present-day run (corrected rain); paired t-test across the same weather years
hr_chg <- data.table::rbindlist(lapply(c("cf1", "cf2"), function(f) data.table::rbindlist(lapply(names(hr_meas), function(m) {
  a <- hr_wy[run == "present"][order(wy)][[m]]; b <- hr_wy[run == f][order(wy)][[m]]
  data.table::data.table(cf = f, m = m, present = mean(a), future = mean(b), pct = 100 * (mean(b) / mean(a) - 1),
                         p = stats::t.test(b, a, paired = TRUE)$p.value)
}))))
# How the present-day run compares with observed rain at the same place, 1991-2009, before
# (ratio_raw) and after (ratio) the correction
# Average of each yearly measure over the years, as a long table (one row per measure)
avg <- function(d, lab) data.table::melt(wy_stats(d)[, lapply(.SD, mean), .SDcols = setdiff(names(hr_meas), "hmax")],
                                         measure.vars = setdiff(names(hr_meas), "hmax"), variable.name = "m", value.name = lab)
hr_bias <- Reduce(function(a, b) merge(a, b, by = "m"),
                  list(avg(obs_hr, "obs"), avg(hr_daily[run == "present", .(date, pr = pr_raw, wy, wet)], "raw"), avg(hr_daily[run == "present"], "cor")))
hr_bias[, `:=`(m = as.character(m), ratio_raw = raw / obs, ratio = cor / obs)]
# How closely the present-day run's weather follows the real weather: day by day, water year by
# water year, and the driest three water years in a row (mm)
hr_vs_obs <- merge(obs_hr[, .(date, wy, obs = pr)], hr_daily[run == "present", .(date, model = pr)], by = "date")
hr_skill <- hr_vs_obs[, .(obs = sum(obs), model = sum(model)), by = wy][order(wy)][
  , .(r_day = hr_vs_obs[, stats::cor(obs, model)], r_wy = stats::cor(obs, model),
      min3_obs = min(data.table::frollsum(obs, 3), na.rm = TRUE), min3_model = min(data.table::frollsum(model, 3), na.rm = TRUE))]
# Mean monthly rain, observed and in each run; each future's change in each month
hr_mon <- rbind(obs_hr[, .(run = "observed", r = mean(pr)), by = month], hr_daily[, .(r = mean(pr)), by = .(run, month)])[, mm := r * days_in_month[month]]
mon_fac <- merge(hr_mon[run %in% c("cf1", "cf2")], hr_mon[run == "present", .(month, r0 = r)], by = "month")[, fac := r / r0]
```

```{r proc-futures, include = FALSE}
# ---- Rain for the tank model: the corrected runs themselves, day by day --------------------
cf_lab <- c(present = paste0("Present-day run (", min(hr_wys), "-", max(hr_wys), ")"),
            cf1 = "Climate Future 1 (RCP 4.5)", cf2 = "Climate Future 2 (RCP 8.5)")
cf_cols <- c(present = "#7f7f7f", cf1 = "#9A9EE5", cf2 = "#E10720")    # colours of the NPS climate-futures scripts (NPS_HI_Climate_Data/)
# Daily rain matrix for the tank model: one column per run, one row per day
P <- sapply(names(cf_lab), function(r) hr_daily[run == r]$pr)
# Checks of the correction (appendix): observed rain on the same days, and a month-by-month
# correction in place of the seasonal one
hr_k_mon <- merge(obs_hr[, .(obs = mean(pr)), by = month], hr_daily[run == "present", .(model = mean(pr_raw)), by = month], by = "month")[, k := obs / model]
P_mon <- sapply(names(cf_lab), function(r) hr_daily[run == r][, pr_raw * hr_k_mon$k[match(month, hr_k_mon$month)]])
colnames(P_mon) <- paste0(colnames(P_mon), "_monthly")
P_chk <- cbind(observed = obs_hr$pr, P_mon)
```

```{r proc-demand, include = FALSE}
# ---- Use: visitation (NPS IRMA) and the system's users --------------------------------
# Monthly visitor statistics from NPS IRMA (recreation visits, tent campers, etc.), saved by
# getUnitVisitation() in proc-download
vis <- data.table::as.data.table(arrow::read_parquet(f_visits))
vis_y <- vis[, .(visitors = sum(RecreationVisitors), tent = sum(TentCampers), months = .N), by = Year][months == 12][order(Year)]
vis_trend <- list(sen = 10 * unname(trend::sens.slope(vis_y$visitors)$estimates), p = trend::mk.test(vis_y$visitors)$p.value)
vis_recent <- vis_y[Year >= max(Year) - 3]
ut21_gpd <- 2000 / 7                                                  # weekly 2,000-gal haul (WSD)

# Recreation.gov reservations (RIDB historical reservation data, one file per fiscal year):
# Hosmer Grove Campground (facility 10068557) and the summit sunrise reservations (253731).
# Rows repeated across yearly files are dropped; years are fiscal years (Oct-Sep) of the
# reservation's start date, kept only when complete.
# Saved by get_ridb_reservations() in proc-download, which downloads each fiscal year's national
# reservation file (0.1-0.5 GB zip) and keeps only these facilities' rows (res_ids)
res <- data.table::as.data.table(arrow::read_parquet(f_res))
res <- unique(res, by = "historicalreservationid")
res[, `:=`(fac = names(res_ids)[match(facilityid, res_ids)], start = as.Date(substr(startdate, 1, 10)), end = as.Date(substr(enddate, 1, 10)))]
res[, `:=`(fy = as.integer(format(start, "%Y")) + (as.integer(format(start, "%m")) >= 10L), month = as.integer(format(start, "%m")),
           nights_n = pmax(1, as.numeric(end - start)), people = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(numberofpeople)))]
res_first <- res[, .(first = min(start)), by = fac]                     # first booking: partial first year is dropped below
res_fy <- res[, .(reservations = .N, site_nights = sum(nights_n), person_nights = sum(nights_n * people, na.rm = TRUE)), by = .(fac, fy)]
res_fy <- merge(res_fy, res_first, by = "fac")[fy > as.integer(format(first, "%Y")) + (as.integer(format(first, "%m")) >= 10L)][order(fac, fy)]
# Bookings per night. The files keep reservations later cancelled or changed (no flag), so
# a night can show more bookings than sites; report how often every site was booked instead.
res_night <- res[res_fy[fac == "hosmer", .(fac, fy)], on = .(fac, fy), nomatch = 0][
  , .(d = as.numeric(seq(start, max(start, end - 1), by = "day"))), by = historicalreservationid][, .N, by = d]
res_stat <- list(hos_full = 100 * mean(res_night$N >= hosmer_cap$sites),
                 hos_people = res[fac == "hosmer" & fy %in% res_fy[fac == "hosmer"]$fy, mean(people, na.rm = TRUE)],
                 sun_day = stats::median(res[res_fy[fac == "sunrise", .(fac, fy)], on = .(fac, fy), nomatch = 0][, .N, by = start]$N))
# Share of each facility's reservations falling in each month, over its complete fiscal years
res_mon <- res[res_fy[, .(fac, fy)], on = .(fac, fy), nomatch = 0][, .(n = .N), by = .(fac, month)][, share := 100 * n / sum(n), by = fac]
```

```{r proc-tank, include = FALSE}
# ---- Can 550,000 gallons of storage meet demand? Daily yield-after-spillage tank model ----
# Every assumption (C_eff, dem_gpd, catchment_acres) is set at the top of the report's constants
# chunk and marked {{ASSUMPTION}} in the text.
gpd_grid <- c(1000, 2000, 3000, 4000, 5000, 6000, 7500, 10000)
area_grid <- c(seq(0.1, 20, by = 0.1), seq(20.25, 80, by = 0.25))   # acres
# hi_catchment_needed(): runs the daily tank model (hi_tank_yas(): each day supply the smaller of
# demand and what the treated tank holds, add the day's catch to the raw-water tanks, spilling
# anything over their capacity, then filter up to filter_gpd from the raw into the treated tank) for
# every rain series x demand x catchment area, and returns the smallest area with no shortfall
# on any day. Catch (gallons) = rain (mm) x area (m²) x collection efficiency x 0.264 gal/L.
need <- hi_catchment_needed(cbind(P, P_chk), summit_storage, gpd_grid, area_grid, eff = C_eff,
                            treated_gal = treated_gal, filter_gpd = filter_gpd)
# Check (appendix): the same with the partly missing model days counted as dry instead of filled
P_dry <- P
for (i in seq_len(nrow(hr_miss))) P_dry[match(hr_miss$date[i], hr_days), hr_miss$run[i]] <- 0
need_dry <- hi_catchment_needed(P_dry, summit_storage, dem_gpd, area_grid, eff = C_eff,
                                treated_gal = treated_gal, filter_gpd = filter_gpd)
# The placeholder catchment: just large enough to meet the assumed demand in the present-day
# run, unless set explicitly
acres <- if (is.na(catchment_acres)) need[CF == "present" & gpd == dem_gpd]$acres_100 else catchment_acres
short_dry <- sapply(colnames(P_dry), function(x) sum(hi_shortfall_days(P_dry[, x], acres * m2_per_acre, summit_storage, dem_gpd, eff = C_eff,
                                                                    treated_gal = treated_gal, filter_gpd = filter_gpd)))
# Daily storage trace for the figure, and shortfall days: the same tank model (hi_tank_trace()),
# run once per series at the placeholder catchment and assumed demand; storage is all tanks
trace <- data.table::rbindlist(lapply(colnames(P), function(s) {
  data.table::data.table(CF = s, date = hr_days,
                         hi_tank_trace(P[, s], acres * m2_per_acre, summit_storage, dem_gpd, eff = C_eff,
                                       treated_gal = treated_gal, filter_gpd = filter_gpd))
}))
trace[, `:=`(month = as.integer(format(date, "%m")), wy = hi_water_year(as.integer(format(date, "%Y")), as.integer(format(date, "%m"))))]
short_sum <- trace[, .(short_days = sum(short), short_yr = 365.25 * mean(short), min_pct = 100 * min(storage) / summit_storage,
                       years_short = data.table::uniqueN(wy[short]),
                       longest = { r <- rle(short); if (any(r$values)) max(r$lengths[r$values]) else 0L }), by = CF]
short_mon <- trace[short == TRUE, .N, by = .(CF, month)]                # when in the year shortfalls fall
# Check (appendix): the same steps with other model cells around the system: the nearest cell
# alone, it and its nearer east-west neighbour, and the 2 x 2 blocks just north and south of those
# two. The system's point sits near the edge between two columns, so no 2 x 2 block is centred on it.
# Each set gets its own seasonal correction and its own present-day catchment.
hr_cell_rain <- data.table::rbindlist(lapply(names(hr_runs), function(r) {
  x <- data.table::as.data.table(arrow::read_parquet(file.path(hrcm_dir, paste0(hr_runs[[r]], ".parquet"))))
  merge(hr_cells[, .(we, sn)], x, by = c("we", "sn"))[, run := r]
}))
c0 <- hr_cells[which.min(dist_km)]
we2 <- hr_cells[sn == c0$sn & we != c0$we][which.min(dist_km)]$we
hr_cell_sets <- list(nearest = data.table::data.table(we = c0$we, sn = c0$sn),
                     pair = data.table::data.table(we = c(c0$we, we2), sn = c0$sn),
                     north = data.table::CJ(we = c(c0$we, we2), sn = c0$sn + 0:1),
                     south = data.table::CJ(we = c(c0$we, we2), sn = c0$sn - 1:0))
hr_cell_sens <- data.table::rbindlist(lapply(names(hr_cell_sets), function(s) {
  hh <- merge(hr_cell_sets[[s]], hr_cell_rain, by = c("we", "sn"))[, .(rain_mm = mean(rain_mm)), by = .(run, time_utc)]
  d <- hh[, hi_hrcm_daily(.SD[, .(system = "Summit District", time_utc, rain_mm)], "system"), by = run]
  d <- merge(data.table::CJ(run = names(hr_runs), date = hr_days), d[, .(run, date, pr)], by = c("run", "date"), all.x = TRUE)
  part <- hh[, .(run, date = as.Date(time_utc - 3600 - 10 * 3600, tz = "UTC"), rain_mm)][
    , .(pr_fill = sum(rain_mm, na.rm = TRUE) * 24 / sum(!is.na(rain_mm))), by = .(run, date)]
  d[part, on = .(run, date), pr := data.table::fifelse(is.na(pr), i.pr_fill, pr)]
  stopifnot(all(is.finite(d$pr)))
  d[, wet := as.integer(format(date, "%m")) %in% wet_months]
  k <- merge(obs_hr[, .(obs = mean(pr)), by = wet], d[run == "present", .(model = mean(pr)), by = wet], by = "wet")[, k := obs / model]
  d[, pr := pr * k$k[match(wet, k$wet)]]
  Ps <- sapply(names(cf_lab), function(r) d[run == r][order(date)]$pr)
  a <- hi_catchment_needed(Ps, summit_storage, dem_gpd, area_grid, eff = C_eff, treated_gal = treated_gal, filter_gpd = filter_gpd)
  a <- stats::setNames(a$acres_100, a$CF)
  data.table::data.table(set = s, cf = c("cf1", "cf2"), more = 100 * (a[c("cf1", "cf2")] / a[["present"]] - 1),
    short = sapply(c("cf1", "cf2"), function(f) sum(hi_shortfall_days(Ps[, f], a[["present"]] * m2_per_acre, summit_storage, dem_gpd,
                                                                      eff = C_eff, treated_gal = treated_gal, filter_gpd = filter_gpd))),
    ann = sapply(c("cf1", "cf2"), function(f) 100 * (sum(Ps[, f]) / sum(Ps[, "present"]) - 1)))
}))
stopifnot(nrow(hr_cell_sens) == 8, all(hr_cell_sens$more > 0), all(hr_cell_sens$ann < 0))
```

```{r proc-storms, include = FALSE}
# ---- Severe storms: what has happened (NOAA, NWS, HCDP) and what the futures show (HRCM wind) ----
# Past: NOAA Storm Events in the Haleakalā summit forecast zone (wind magnitudes are gusts in
# knots), Maui events in 2026, and the NWS alerts issued for that zone.
storm_ev <- data.table::as.data.table(arrow::read_parquet(f_storm))
storm_ev[, `:=`(date = as.Date(paste0(begin_yearmonth, sprintf("%02d", as.integer(begin_day))), "%Y%m%d"),
                kt = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(magnitude)))]
summit_ev <- storm_ev[cz_name == "HALEAKALA SUMMIT" & event_type %in% c("High Wind", "Strong Wind", "Winter Storm", "Winter Weather")][order(date)]
maui_2026 <- storm_ev[format(date, "%Y") == "2026" & grepl("MAUI|HALEAKALA", cz_name) &
                        event_type %in% c("High Wind", "Strong Wind", "Flash Flood", "Flood", "Heavy Rain")][order(date)]
dmg_usd <- function(x) { m <- c(K = 1e3, M = 1e6, B = 1e9)[sub(".*([KMB])$", "\\1", x)]; suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sub("[KMB]$", "", x))) * ifelse(is.na(m), 1, m) }
alerts <- data.table::as.data.table(arrow::read_parquet(f_alerts))
alert_n <- alerts[, .N, by = name]
# The park's own alerts (NPS, daily snapshots of posted alerts): one row per alert text, with the
# first and last day it was seen. Used for outages, closures and drought in the text.
park_alerts <- data.table::rbindlist(lapply(list.files(park_alerts_dir, "\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE), function(f)
  data.table::as.data.table(readRDS(f))[UNIT_CODE == park]))
pa <- park_alerts[, .(first = min(date), last = max(date)), by = Description][order(first)]
pa_has <- function(pattern) any(grepl(pattern, pa$Description, ignore.case = TRUE))   # guards for statements in the text
pa_last_seen <- max(park_alerts$date)
# Observed extreme rain at the Summit District (HCDP rain maps)
obs_top <- obs[!is.na(pr)][order(-pr)][1:5, .(date, pr_in = pr / 25.4)]
# Future: hourly 10-m wind at the Summit District's 9 cells in each run (m/s -> mph). The futures
# replay the same weather, so this shows how the same storms' winds change, not how often
# storms come. Hourly means, not gusts.
hr_wind <- data.table::rbindlist(lapply(names(hr_runs), function(r) {
  w <- data.table::as.data.table(arrow::read_parquet(file.path(hrcm_dir, paste0(hr_runs[[r]], "_wind.parquet"))))
  w[, .(spd = mean(sqrt(u10^2 + v10^2)), u = mean(u10), v = mean(v10)), by = time_utc][, run := r]
}))
hr_wind[, `:=`(mph = spd * 2.23694, dir_from = (atan2(-u, -v) * 180 / pi) %% 360,
               month = as.integer(format(time_utc - 10 * 3600, "%m")), year = as.integer(format(time_utc - 10 * 3600, "%Y")))]
hr_wind[, wy := hi_water_year(year, month)]
wind_thr <- stats::quantile(hr_wind[run == "present" & wy %in% hr_wys]$mph, 0.99)   # strong wind: top 1% of present-day hours
wind_wy <- hr_wind[wy %in% hr_wys, .(max_mph = max(mph), strong_h = sum(mph >= wind_thr),
                                     kona_h = sum(mph >= wind_thr & dir_from >= 135 & dir_from <= 315)), by = .(run, wy)]
wind_chg <- data.table::rbindlist(lapply(c("cf1", "cf2"), function(f) data.table::rbindlist(lapply(c("max_mph", "strong_h", "kona_h"), function(m) {
  a <- wind_wy[run == "present"][order(wy)][[m]]; b <- wind_wy[run == f][order(wy)][[m]]
  data.table::data.table(cf = f, m = m, present = mean(a), future = mean(b), pct = 100 * (mean(b) / mean(a) - 1),
                         p = stats::t.test(b, a, paired = TRUE)$p.value) }))))
```

```{r proc-figures, include = FALSE}
# ---- Figure: the water systems on NPS Park Tiles, with mean annual rain -------------------
# tiles_for(): NPS Park Tiles basemap for a box (Web Mercator metres), saved as a GeoTIFF; the
# tiles are downloaded (get_nps_basemap()) only when rerun_downloads is TRUE, otherwise the saved
# file is read. geom_nps_basemap() draws them under other layers.
tiles_for <- function(xlim, ylim, style, zoom, file) {
  f <- file.path("hi_datasets", paste0(park, "_nps_", file, ".tif"))
  if (rerun_downloads) {
    aoi <- sf::st_as_sf(sf::st_as_sfc(sf::st_bbox(c(xmin = xlim[1], xmax = xlim[2], ymin = ylim[1], ymax = ylim[2]), crs = 3857)))
    terra::writeRaster(get_nps_basemap(aoi, style = style, buffer_km = 0.3, zoom = zoom), f, overwrite = TRUE)
  }
  terra::rast(f)
}
rain_3857 <- terra::project(mean_r, "EPSG:3857")
rain_df <- terra::as.data.frame(rain_3857, xy = TRUE)
iso_in <- c(30, 50, 80, 120, 200)                                      # isohyets (inches)
# Contour lines (isohyets) of mean annual rain at the inch values in iso_in
iso_all <- do.call(rbind, lapply(iso_in, function(v) {
  l <- sf::st_as_sf(terra::as.contour(rain_3857, levels = v * 25.4)); if (nrow(l)) l$inch <- v; l[, "inch"] }))
# to_m(): labeled points from lon/lat, in the map's Web Mercator CRS
to_m <- function(lon, lat, lab) sf::st_sf(lab = lab, geometry = sf::st_transform(sf::st_sfc(lapply(seq_along(lon), function(i) sf::st_point(c(lon[i], lat[i]))), crs = 4326), 3857))
cat_m <- sf::st_transform(summit_pt, 3857)
# Where the catchment's water is used: visitor centers from recreation.gov; Hosmer Grove Campground
# from OpenStreetMap (camp_site node 571276260; recreation.gov lists it at 0, 0). Housing,
# maintenance and the entrance station are also served but have no published coordinates.
hosmer_ll <- c(lon = -156.2376620, lat = 20.7685116)
use_m <- to_m(c(hq_vc$FacilityLongitude, hosmer_ll[["lon"]], vc$FacilityLongitude),
              c(hq_vc$FacilityLatitude, hosmer_ll[["lat"]], vc$FacilityLatitude),
              c("Park Headquarters\nVisitor Center", "Hosmer Grove\nCampground", "Haleakalā Visitor Center\n(water hauled weekly)"))
vc_m <- use_m[3, ]
gauge_m <- to_m(gauge_meta$longitude, gauge_meta$latitude, gauge_use[gauge_meta$id])
xy <- function(g) sf::st_coordinates(g)[1, ]                           # x, y of a point
park_m <- sf::st_transform(park_boundary, 3857)
rain_fill <- scale_fill_gradientn("Mean annual rain,\n1991-2025 (in)", colours = c("#F3E3C3", "#C9D8A8", "#7DB8A6", "#3C8DA3", "#23557E", "#1B2F59"),
                                  trans = "log10", limits = c(30, 240), breaks = c(30, 60, 120, 240),
                                  labels = c("<30", "60", "120", ">240"), oob = scales::squish)   # rain outside 30-240 in takes the end colours
# The map: rain, isohyets, park outline on top, the system and where its water goes, the gauges
gx <- xy(gauge_m[grepl("Kula", gauge_m$lab), ])
xl_a <- c(min(range(rain_df$x)[1], gx[1]) - 1500, range(rain_df$x)[2] + 1200); yl_a <- range(rain_df$y) + c(-1200, 4000)
tiles_a <- tiles_for(xl_a, yl_a, "light", 12, "park_light_wide2")
# Labels placed by hand (offsets in metres from each point), joined to their points by thin leader lines
lab_pts <- data.table::data.table(
  lab = c("Summit District rain catchment\nand 550,000-gal tanks", "Hosmer Grove\nCampground",
          "Park Headquarters Visitor Center\nand Summit District gauge", "Haleakalā Visitor Center\n(water hauled weekly)", "Kula gauge"),
  x = c(xy(cat_m)[1], xy(use_m[2, ])[1], xy(use_m[1, ])[1], xy(vc_m)[1], gx[1]),
  y = c(xy(cat_m)[2], xy(use_m[2, ])[2], xy(use_m[1, ])[2], xy(vc_m)[2], gx[2]),
  dx = c(-4600, 5200, -4400, -5200, 0), dy = c(2700, 2300, -3300, -3000, 2400))
lab_pts[, `:=`(lx = x + dx, ly = y + dy)]
p_map_a <- ggplot() + geom_nps_basemap(tiles_a) +
  geom_raster(data = rain_df, aes(x, y, fill = pr_mm / 25.4), alpha = 0.7) + rain_fill +
  geom_sf(data = iso_all, color = "grey20", linewidth = 0.25, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_sf_text(data = sf::st_point_on_surface(iso_all), aes(label = paste0(inch, " in")), size = 2.2, color = "grey10") +
  geom_sf(data = park_m, fill = NA, color = "#3b2a1a", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_segment(data = lab_pts, aes(x = x, y = y, xend = lx, yend = ly), linewidth = 0.25, color = "grey25") +
  geom_sf(data = gauge_m, aes(shape = "Rain gauge"), size = 4, fill = "#1FB5C2", stroke = 0.8) +
  geom_sf(data = cat_m, aes(shape = "Rain catchment and tanks"), size = 5.5, fill = "#B03A2E", stroke = 1) +
  geom_sf(data = use_m, aes(shape = "Uses the system's water"), size = 3.2, fill = "#F2A900", stroke = 0.8) +
  scale_shape_manual(NULL, values = c("Rain catchment and tanks" = 21, "Uses the system's water" = 22, "Rain gauge" = 24),
                     guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(fill = c("#B03A2E", "#1FB5C2", "#F2A900"), size = c(4, 3.4, 3.2)))) +
  geom_label(data = lab_pts, aes(lx, ly, label = lab), size = 2.3, lineheight = 0.95, label.size = 0.15,
             label.padding = grid::unit(0.15, "lines"), fill = scales::alpha("white", 0.92)) +
  coord_sf(crs = 3857, expand = FALSE, xlim = xl_a, ylim = yl_a) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_void(base_size = 8) + theme(legend.position = "left", legend.box = "vertical")
# Inset: Maui, with the park highlighted
maui <- sf::st_as_sf(sf::st_as_sfc(sf::st_bbox(c(xmin = -156.72, xmax = -155.95, ymin = 20.55, ymax = 21.05), crs = 4326)))
mb <- as.list(unclass(sf::st_bbox(sf::st_transform(maui, 3857))))   # plain numbers (named bbox values break tiles_for())
tiles_maui <- tiles_for(c(mb$xmin, mb$xmax), c(mb$ymin, mb$ymax), "light", 9, "maui_light")
p_maui <- ggplot() + geom_nps_basemap(tiles_maui) +
  geom_sf(data = park_m, fill = "#B03A2E", color = "#B03A2E", alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.3) +
  annotate("text", x = mean(c(mb$xmin, mb$xmax)) - 15000, y = mb$ymax - 9000, label = "Maui", size = 3, fontface = "bold") +
  coord_sf(crs = 3857, expand = FALSE, xlim = c(mb$xmin, mb$xmax), ylim = c(mb$ymin, mb$ymax)) +
  theme_void() + theme(panel.border = element_rect(color = "grey30", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5))
figs$map <- list(p = p_map_a + patchwork::inset_element(p_maui, left = 0, bottom = 0, right = 0.3, top = 0.36, align_to = "panel") +
                   patchwork::plot_annotation(caption = paste0("Basemap: NPS Park Tiles. Catchment location from the NPS Water Supply Database (location confidence: low); other locations from recreation.gov, OpenStreetMap and NOAA GHCN-Daily.\n",
                                                               "Isohyets: HCDP rain maps, mean annual rain, Hawaiʻi water years 1991-2025. Housing, maintenance areas and the entrance station also use the system's water but are not mapped."),
                                              theme = theme(plot.caption = element_text(size = 7, hjust = 0))),
                 w = 9, h = 5.6)
save_fig(figs$map$p, "Summit_map", 9, 5.6)

# ---- Figure: rain is already changing at the Summit District -----------------------------------
# (a) amount: gauge and HCDP map; (b) timing: monthly rain, first vs. second half of the
# gauge record; (c) rain days and (d) dry spells: gauge only (event counts from interpolated
# daily maps are not comparable with a gauge)
src_lab <- c(Gauge = rs_lab, `HCDP map` = "HCDP rain maps, Summit District")
src_col <- c(Gauge = "#1B2F59", `HCDP map` = "#E1A33B")
ann_d <- rbind(rs[, .(src = "Gauge", water_year, v = annual_mm / 25.4)], hcdp_i[, .(src = "HCDP map", water_year, v = annual_mm / 25.4)])
ann_d[, roll := data.table::frollmean(v, 10, align = "center"), by = src]
# One trend panel: yearly points joined by a light grey line, plus the 10-year running mean
tr_panel <- function(d, ylab, title) ggplot(d, aes(water_year, v, color = src)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = src), color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_point(size = 0.9, alpha = 0.5) + geom_line(aes(y = roll), linewidth = 1.1, na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_color_manual(NULL, values = src_col, labels = src_lab) +
  labs(x = "Hawaiʻi water year", y = ylab, title = title) + theme_cf
p_t_a <- tr_panel(ann_d, "Rain (in)", "(a) How much: annual rain")
ev <- data.table::melt(rs[, .(src = "Gauge", water_year, wet_days, cdd_dry_season)], id.vars = c("src", "water_year"))[
  , roll := data.table::frollmean(value, 10, align = "center"), by = variable]
p_t_c <- tr_panel(ev[variable == "wet_days", .(src, water_year, v = value, roll)], "Days per year", "(c) Rain days (≥ 0.04 in)")
p_t_d <- tr_panel(ev[variable == "cdd_dry_season", .(src, water_year, v = value, roll)], "Days", "(d) Longest dry-season dry spell")
# hi_wy_month() / hi_scale_x_wy_month(): order months Nov ... Oct (the Hawaiʻi water year) on the x axis
p_t_b <- ggplot(rs_mon[, .(half = factor(rs_halves[half], rs_halves), m = hi_wy_month(month), v = mm / 25.4)], aes(m, v, fill = half)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 6.5, xmax = 12.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "grey93") +   # dry season, May-Oct (as in Figure 6)
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.75) + hi_scale_x_wy_month() +
  scale_fill_manual("Hawaiʻi water years", values = c("#9ECAE1", "#1B2F59")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean monthly rain (in)", title = "(b) When: monthly rain at the gauge") + theme_cf
inside <- theme(legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(0.98, 0.98), legend.justification = c(1, 1),
                legend.background = element_rect(fill = scales::alpha("white", 0.85), color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.2),
                legend.title = element_text(size = 7), legend.text = element_text(size = 7))
figs$trend <- list(p = patchwork::wrap_plots(p_t_a + theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.direction = "vertical"), p_t_b + inside,
                                             p_t_c + theme(legend.position = "none"), p_t_d + theme(legend.position = "none"), ncol = 2) +
                     patchwork::plot_annotation(caption = paste0("Points: each complete Hawaiʻi water year. Lines: 10-year running mean. Panels (c) and (d): ", rs_lab, " (Haleakalā Ranger Station, ", scales::comma(round(gauge_meta[id == "USC00511004"]$elevation * 3.28084)), " ft)."),
                                                theme = theme(plot.caption = element_text(size = 7))), w = 8.5, h = 6.2)
save_fig(figs$trend$p, "Summit_rain_trends", 8.5, 6.2)

# ---- Figure: the rain shadow is widening (2,000-mm line each water year; area each water year) ---
yr_col <- scale_color_gradientn("Hawaiʻi\nwater year", colours = grDevices::hcl.colors(9, "Spectral", rev = TRUE),
                                limits = range(iso_wy), breaks = seq(1995, 2025, 10))
# Over the NPS basemap saved for the report map (it covers the whole park), cropped to the park
pb <- sf::st_bbox(park_m)
p_iso_a <- ggplot() + geom_nps_basemap(tiles_a) +
  geom_sf(data = park_m, fill = NA, color = "#3b2a1a", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_sf(data = iso_lines_wy, aes(color = wy), linewidth = 0.45, alpha = 0.9) + yr_col +
  geom_sf(data = summit_pt, shape = 21, fill = "#B03A2E", size = 2.4) +
  coord_sf(crs = 3857, expand = FALSE, xlim = pb[c("xmin", "xmax")] + c(-800, 800), ylim = pb[c("ymin", "ymax")] + c(-800, 800)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = "(a) Where the 79-inch line sits, each year") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 8) + theme(legend.position = "none")
# Sen's slope line through the median point, for panel (b)
iso_fit <- data.table::data.table(wy = range(iso_area$wy))[, km2 := stats::median(iso_area$km2) + iso_trend$sen / 10 * (wy - stats::median(iso_area$wy))]
# Background: El Niño / La Niña winters shaded; PDO phase as a band along the top
shade <- climate_wy[wy %in% iso_wy]
ytop <- max(iso_area$km2) * 1.12
enso_fill <- c("El Niño" = "#F6D3B5", "La Niña" = "#C9DDEE", "Positive PDO" = "#D9822B", "Negative PDO" = "#3E7CB1")
p_iso_b <- ggplot(iso_area, aes(wy, km2)) +
  geom_rect(data = shade[enso != "Neutral"], aes(xmin = wy - 0.5, xmax = wy + 0.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = ytop * 0.955, fill = enso),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_rect(data = shade, aes(xmin = wy - 0.5, xmax = wy + 0.5, ymin = ytop * 0.97, ymax = ytop, fill = phase), inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(NULL, values = enso_fill, breaks = names(enso_fill)) +
  geom_line(color = "grey55", linewidth = 0.4) + geom_point(aes(color = wy), size = 1.8) + yr_col +
  geom_line(data = iso_fit, color = "black", linewidth = 0.7, linetype = "22") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, ytop), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.01))) +
  labs(x = "Hawaiʻi water year", y = "Park area with ≥ 79 in of rain (km²)", title = "(b) How much of the park gets it") +
  theme_cf + theme(legend.box = "vertical") + guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE), color = guide_colorbar(barwidth = 8, barheight = 0.5))
figs$shadow <- list(p = patchwork::wrap_plots(p_iso_a, p_iso_b, nrow = 1, widths = c(1.45, 1)), w = 9, h = 5)
save_fig(figs$shadow$p, "Summit_rain_shadow", 9, 5)

# ---- Figure: rain at the catchment in the two futures (HRCM) ---------------------------------
show_m <- c("ann", "dry_mm", "wet_mm", "rain_days", "cdd_dry", "wet_spell", "heavy", "rx1", "hmax")
hc <- hr_chg[m %in% show_m][, `:=`(meas = factor(hr_meas[m], rev(hr_meas[show_m])), cf = factor(cf_lab[cf], cf_lab[c("cf2", "cf1")]),
                                  sig = p < 0.05)]
hc <- merge(hc, hr_bias[, .(m, ratio)], by = "m", all.x = TRUE)
hc[, caution := !is.na(ratio) & (ratio < 2 / 3 | ratio > 1.5)]
# group = cf: bars and labels dodge by future only (not by significance), so labels stay on their bars
p_hr <- ggplot(hc, aes(pct, meas, fill = cf, group = cf)) + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), width = 0.7, aes(alpha = sig, color = cf), linewidth = 0.3, show.legend = c(color = FALSE)) +
  scale_color_manual(NULL, values = stats::setNames(cf_cols[c("cf1", "cf2")], cf_lab[c("cf1", "cf2")]), guide = "none") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(ifelse(pct > 0, "+", ""), round(pct), "%"), hjust = ifelse(pct >= 0, -0.15, 1.15)),
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), size = 2.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(NULL, values = c(cf_cols[["cf1"]], cf_cols[["cf2"]]) |> stats::setNames(cf_lab[c("cf1", "cf2")]), breaks = unname(cf_lab[c("cf1", "cf2")])) +
  scale_alpha_manual(NULL, values = c(`TRUE` = 1, `FALSE` = 0.35), labels = c(`TRUE` = "Significant (p < 0.05)", `FALSE` = "Not significant")) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.2)) +
  labs(x = "Change, late century vs. present-day run (%)", y = NULL) + theme_cf + theme(legend.box = "vertical")
# save_fig(): writes the PNG to data/park/HALE/Figs/ and returns the plot with its width and height
# (used by the report's chunk options)
figs$hrcm <- save_fig(p_hr, "Summit_HRCM_changes", 7, 4.6)

# ---- Figure: the same statistics year by year (present-day run grey; futures purple and red) --
# All three runs replay the same 19 weather years, so they are overlaid by year of the run
# (year 1 = water year 1991 in the present-day run; the futures stand for 2081-2099).
run_year_x <- scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1, 5, 10, 15, 19), labels = function(b) paste("Year", b))
ts_unit <- c(ann = "in", dry_mm = "in", wet_mm = "in", rain_days = "days", cdd_dry = "days", wet_spell = "days",
             heavy = "days", rx1 = "in", hmax = "in")
hts <- data.table::melt(hr_wy[, c("run", "wy", show_m), with = FALSE], id.vars = c("run", "wy"), variable.name = "m")
hts[, `:=`(m = as.character(m), year = wy - min(hr_wys) + 1L)]
hts[ts_unit[m] == "in", value := value / 25.4]
hts[, panel := factor(paste0(hr_meas[m], " (", ts_unit[m], ")"), paste0(hr_meas[show_m], " (", ts_unit[show_m], ")"))]
hts[, cfl := factor(cf_lab[run], cf_lab)]
p_hts <- ggplot(hts, aes(year, value, color = cfl, group = cfl)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.85) + geom_point(size = 1.3, alpha = 0.9) +
  facet_wrap(~panel, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y", strip.position = "top") +
  scale_color_manual(NULL, values = stats::setNames(cf_cols, cf_lab)) +
  run_year_x + labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) + theme_cf
figs$hrcm_ts <- save_fig(p_hts, "Summit_HRCM_timeseries", 7.5, 15)

# ---- Figure: when rain falls (observed vs. corrected present-day run; the runs' monthly change) --
mon_src <- c(observed = "Observed (HCDP)", present = "Present-day run, corrected")
p_mon_a <- ggplot(hr_mon[run %in% names(mon_src), .(src = factor(mon_src[run], mon_src), m = hi_wy_month(month), v = mm / 25.4)], aes(m, v, fill = src)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 6.5, xmax = 12.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "grey93") +

  scale_fill_manual(NULL, values = stats::setNames(c("#3C8DA3", cf_cols[["present"]]), mon_src)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean monthly rain (in)", title = paste0("(a) Observed and model, ", min(hr_wys), "-", max(hr_wys))) + theme_cf
p_mon_b <- ggplot(mon_fac[, .(cf = factor(cf_lab[run], cf_lab[c("cf1", "cf2")]), m = hi_wy_month(month), pct = 100 * (fac - 1))], aes(m, pct, fill = cf)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 6.5, xmax = 12.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "grey93") +

  scale_fill_manual(NULL, values = stats::setNames(cf_cols[c("cf1", "cf2")], cf_lab[c("cf1", "cf2")])) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Change in monthly rain (%)", title = "(b) Change in each month, model runs") + theme_cf
figs$monthly <- list(p = patchwork::wrap_plots(p_mon_a, p_mon_b, nrow = 1, widths = c(1, 1.3)), w = 8, h = 3.3)

# ---- Figure: visitation -----------------------------------------------------------------------
p_vis <- ggplot(vis_y, aes(Year, visitors / 1e6)) + geom_col(fill = "#3C8DA3", width = 0.8) +

# ---- Figure: lowest storage reached each month ------------------------------------------------
# low (per water year) feeds the text; the figure shows each month's lowest level, one panel per
# run, placed along the run's years (month 1 = November, so year k spans k - 0.5 to k + 0.5)
low <- trace[, .(low = 100 * min(storage) / summit_storage, short = sum(short)), by = .(CF, wy)][, cf := factor(cf_lab[CF], cf_lab)]
low[, run_year := wy - min(hr_wys) + 1L]                               # year of the 19-year run
low_mon <- trace[, .(low = 100 * min(storage) / summit_storage, short = sum(short)), by = .(CF, wy, month)][, cf := factor(cf_lab[CF], cf_lab)]
low_mon[, x := wy - min(hr_wys) + 1L - 0.5 + (hi_wy_month(month) - 0.5) / 12]
p_store <- ggplot(low_mon, aes(x, low, color = cf)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.4, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = short > 0, size = short > 0)) +
  facet_wrap(~cf, ncol = 1) +
  scale_shape_manual(NULL, values = c(`FALSE` = 16, `TRUE` = 4), labels = c(`FALSE` = "Demand met all month", `TRUE` = "Tanks ran dry")) +
  scale_size_manual(NULL, values = c(`FALSE` = 0.6, `TRUE` = 1.8), labels = c(`FALSE` = "Demand met all month", `TRUE` = "Tanks ran dry")) +
  scale_color_manual(NULL, values = stats::setNames(cf_cols, cf_lab), guide = "none") +
  run_year_x + labs(x = NULL, y = "Lowest storage reached in the month (% full)") + theme_cf
figs$storage <- save_fig(p_store, "Summit_lowest_storage", 7.5, 6.5)

lab_all <- c(cf_lab, observed = "Observed rain, same years (check)")
need_plot <- need[CF %in% names(lab_all) & !is.na(acres_100)][, cfl := factor(lab_all[CF], lab_all)]
p_need <- ggplot(need_plot, aes(gpd, acres_100, color = cfl, linetype = cfl)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) + geom_point(size = 1.3) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  scale_y_log10(breaks = c(0.5, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 50), labels = scales::label_number()) +
  scale_color_manual(NULL, values = stats::setNames(c(cf_cols, "black"), lab_all)) +
  scale_linetype_manual(NULL, values = stats::setNames(c("solid", "solid", "solid", "dashed"), lab_all)) +
  labs(x = "Constant demand (gallons per day)", y = "Catchment needed (acres, log scale)") + theme_cf +
  guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE), linetype = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE))
figs$need <- save_fig(p_need, "Summit_catchment_needed", 6.5, 4)

# ---- Figure: severe storms, past (NWS alerts for the summit zone) and future (strong-wind hours) ----
alert_keep <- c("High Wind Warning", "Tropical Storm Warning", "Hurricane Warning", "Winter Storm Warning")
al_y <- alerts[name %in% alert_keep, .N, by = .(y = as.integer(format(issue, "%Y")), name)][, name := factor(name, alert_keep)]
p_st_a <- ggplot(al_y, aes(y, N, fill = name)) + geom_col(width = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(NULL, values = c("#3C8DA3", "#E1A33B", "#B03A2E", "#9ECAE1")) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = function(l) seq(0, ceiling(l[2]), 1)) +
  labs(x = "Calendar year", y = "Warnings issued", title = "(a) NWS warnings, Haleakalā summit zone") + theme_cf + guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2))
p_st_b <- ggplot(wind_wy[, .(cfl = factor(cf_lab[run], cf_lab), year = wy - min(hr_wys) + 1L, strong_h)], aes(year, strong_h, color = cfl)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.85) + geom_point(size = 1.4) + run_year_x +
  scale_color_manual(NULL, values = stats::setNames(cf_cols, cf_lab)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = paste0("Hours with wind ≥ ", round(wind_thr), " mph"), title = "(b) Strong-wind hours, model runs") +
  theme_cf + guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 3))
figs$storms <- list(p = patchwork::wrap_plots(p_st_a, p_st_b, nrow = 1), w = 9, h = 3.8)
save_fig(figs$storms$p, "Summit_storms", 9, 3.8)

# ---- Figure (appendix): the grid cells behind the catchment's rain ----------------------------
# The 3 x 3 HCDP cells (observed rain) and 3 x 3 HRCM cells (model runs) averaged in this report.
# Each cell is drawn as a rectangle half the centre spacing either side of its centre: exact for
# the HCDP grid; the HRCM grid is in its own map projection, so its true edges differ slightly.
cell_polys <- function(d) {
  dlon <- diff(sort(unique(d$lon)))[1] / 2; dlat <- diff(sort(unique(d$lat)))[1] / 2
  sf::st_sf(geometry = sf::st_sfc(lapply(seq_len(nrow(d)), function(i) {
    x <- d$lon[i]; y <- d$lat[i]
    sf::st_polygon(list(rbind(c(x - dlon, y - dlat), c(x + dlon, y - dlat), c(x + dlon, y + dlat), c(x - dlon, y + dlat), c(x - dlon, y - dlat))))
  }), crs = 4326)) %>% sf::st_transform(3857)
}
hc_sf <- cell_polys(data.table::as.data.table(nex_cells)[cell_id %in% sc$cell_id])
hr_sf <- cell_polys(hr_cells)
blk_km <- function(g) sqrt(sum(as.numeric(sf::st_area(sf::st_transform(g, 4326))))) / 1000   # side of a square of the same area
stopifnot(nrow(hc_sf) == 9, nrow(hr_sf) == 9, round(blk_km(hc_sf), 1) == 0.7, round(blk_km(hr_sf), 1) == 2.2)   # as stated in the text
bb <- sf::st_bbox(hr_sf)
xl_c <- c(bb[["xmin"]], bb[["xmax"]]) + c(-900, 900); yl_c <- c(bb[["ymin"]], bb[["ymax"]]) + c(-900, 900)
tiles_c <- tiles_for(xl_c, yl_c, "standard", 15, "catchment_standard")
k_m <- 1 / cos(sf::st_coordinates(summit_pt)[1, 2] * pi / 180)          # Web Mercator metres per ground metre
lab_hc <- paste0("HCDP rain maps: 9 cells, block about ", num(blk_km(hc_sf), 1), " km across")
lab_hr <- paste0("HRCM climate model: 9 cells, block about ", num(blk_km(hr_sf), 1), " km across")
p_cells <- ggplot() + geom_nps_basemap(tiles_c) +
  geom_sf(data = park_m, fill = NA, color = "#3b2a1a", linewidth = 0.6, linetype = "22") +
  geom_sf(data = hr_sf, aes(color = lab_hr), fill = "#C2410C", alpha = 0.10, linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_sf(data = hc_sf, aes(color = lab_hc), fill = "#1F6FB2", alpha = 0.35, linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_sf(data = cat_m, aes(shape = "Catchment location in the WSD (low confidence)"), fill = "#F2A900", color = "black", size = 3.6, stroke = 0.9) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = xl_c[1] + 250, xmax = xl_c[1] + 250 + 1000 * k_m, ymin = yl_c[1] + 250, ymax = yl_c[1] + 295, fill = "black") +
  annotate("text", x = xl_c[1] + 250 + 500 * k_m, y = yl_c[1] + 390, label = "1 km", size = 3.4) +
  scale_color_manual(NULL, values = stats::setNames(c("#1F6FB2", "#C2410C"), c(lab_hc, lab_hr)), breaks = c(lab_hc, lab_hr)) +
  scale_shape_manual(NULL, values = 21) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(order = 1, ncol = 1, override.aes = list(fill = c("#1F6FB2", "#C2410C"), alpha = c(0.35, 0.15))),
         shape = guide_legend(order = 2)) +
  coord_sf(crs = 3857, expand = FALSE, xlim = xl_c, ylim = yl_c) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) + theme_void(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.box = "vertical", legend.box.just = "left", legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))
figs$cells <- save_fig(p_cells, "Summit_rain_cells", 6.5, 7.2)
```

# num()/int()/pc()/sig() (hi_src/hi_report_helpers.R) format numbers, integers, signed % and

acres_at <- function(x) need[need$CF == x & need$gpd == dem_gpd]$acres_100
short_cell <- function(x) paste0(int(short_sum[CF == x]$short_days), " (", short_sum[CF == x]$years_short, " of ", length(hr_wys), " years)")
tabs$bluf <- data.table::data.table(
  Measure = c("Annual rain (in per year)", "Dry-season rain, May-Oct (in per year)", "Rain days (≥ 0.04 in) per year", "Longest dry-season dry spell (days, average year)",
              paste0("Days demand is not met, ", length(hr_wys), " years ", "{{ASSUMPTION}}"), paste0("Catchment needed for ", int(dem_gpd), " gal/day (acres)")),
  present = c(sapply(names(bluf_m), function(m) bluf_m[[m]](hcv("cf1", m)$present)), short_cell("present"), num(acres_at("present"), 1)),
  cf1 = c(sapply(names(bluf_m), function(m) paste0(bluf_m[[m]](hcv("cf1", m)$future), " (", pc(hcv("cf1", m)$pct, 0), ")")), short_cell("cf1"),
          paste0(num(acres_at("cf1"), 1), " (", pc(100 * (acres_at("cf1") / acres_at("present") - 1), 0), ")")),
  cf2 = c(sapply(names(bluf_m), function(m) paste0(bluf_m[[m]](hcv("cf2", m)$future), " (", pc(hcv("cf2", m)$pct, 0), ")")), short_cell("cf2"),
          paste0(num(acres_at("cf2"), 1), " (", pc(100 * (acres_at("cf2") / acres_at("present") - 1), 0), ")")))
# Future names in the headers coloured as in the figures (classes cf1/cf2, defined in the report's CSS)
cf_span <- function(x) paste0('<span class="', x, '">', cf_lab[[x]], "</span>")
data.table::setnames(tabs$bluf, c("Measure", cf_lab[["present"]], cf_span("cf1"), cf_span("cf2")))

tabs$hrcm <- merge(hr_chg[, .(m, cf, present, future, pct, p)], hr_bias[, .(m, ratio_raw, ratio)], by = "m", all.x = TRUE)[
  , .(Measure = hr_meas[m], cf = cf_lab[cf], v = paste0(pc(pct, 0), ifelse(p < 0.05, "*", "")), ratio_raw, ratio)]
tabs$hrcm <- data.table::dcast(tabs$hrcm, Measure + ratio_raw + ratio ~ cf, value.var = "v")[match(hr_meas, Measure)]
data.table::setnames(tabs$hrcm, cf_lab[c("cf1", "cf2")], c(cf_span("cf1"), cf_span("cf2")))
tabs$hrcm[, `:=`(`Present-day run ÷ observed, before correction` = ifelse(is.na(ratio_raw), "—", num(ratio_raw, 2)),
                 `... after correction` = ifelse(is.na(ratio), "—", paste0(num(ratio, 2), ifelse(ratio < 2 / 3 | ratio > 1.5, " (caution)", ""))))][
